tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bde gshegs spyi bstod sems brtse ma ni/ 1$0000300sems can rnams la brtse ba can// 'phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can dag ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtse bcas khyod la phyag= lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi// lan ldon khyod la phyag= rten dang brten par bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' bar// legs ston khyod la phyag= gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad kyis sems can gyi// 'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la phyag= lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa lags par 'tshal// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod la phyag= len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang*// sprul dang yongs su sgyur ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag= thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams la rab slu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la phyag= rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*// spangs dang nges 'byung bgegs mdzad par// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis// mi brdzi khyod la phyag= bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba// 'khor gyi nang na bag brkyang gsung*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa// 'khor sdud khyod la phyag= kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*// gnas pa kun la rtag par ni// kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ste// yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// sems can kun gyi bya ba la/

khyon ni dus las mi 'da' bas// mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba// mi bsnyel khyod la phyag= 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du// lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa// phan dgongs khyod la phyag= spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyod la phyag= sku gsum dag gi byang chub che// rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du// sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod mdzad khyod la phyag= 'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// rnyogs pa mi mnga' mi gnas pa// mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//
༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon med gsar bzhag gis lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
